event.addTournament.intro: Creates a double-elimination bracket to start. You can customize the format, then seed and start it from the Tournament page once entries are in.
event.checkout.cancelled.title: This checkout was canceled
event.create.intro: You'll become its Host. You can edit settings and add co-Hosts afterward.
event.create.location.help: Location is optional: set either, both, or neither. The venue badge is derived from what you fill out.
event.organiser.add.title: Add organizer
event.organiser.search.label: Search users to add as organizer
event.payments.extra.help: Optional labeled percentages added to every order (e.g. “sales tax at 8%”). They apply to all payment methods.
event.receipt.noCurrency: This event hasn't set a currency yet, so these can't be totaled. The host will confirm what you owe.
event.roles.hostScoped: Scoped to a tournament, a Host is credited as that bracket's organizer (a guest host) without gaining event-wide authority.
event.roles.revoke.description: Scope: {scope}. They lose what it lets them do right away. It can be granted again later.
